fields.description: Issue features editorials and satirical columns focused on the April 30, 1927 context of local politics and the upcoming city election in Greater Miami, including commentary on voting, municipal reform, and public-utility franchises. Includes discussion of Florida Power & Light and local transportation (buses/streetcars), courthouse construction contracts, and a column on the Florida East Coast Railway’s use of Black firemen and related labor/race issues. Also references flood relief efforts and Red Cross activity, and contains political advertisements for city commissioner candidates.
